scope: Fresh adversarial comparison of the second-round US scientific supplements; main adjudication incorporates the independent review findings.

G1.rationale: BNL RFI 479547 explicitly seeks outside organizations to procure, thin, surface-treat, characterize, and integrate diamond film for LDRD-26-055. Separate BNL program, order, award, and schedule records establish the buyer context without treating base-detector spend as a future startup order.

G2.rationale: Seven final peer-reviewed records support diamond transmission gain, surface treatment, lifetime, and timing; the unproven cartridge repeatability remains an experiment question.

G3.rationale: The nine-month $94,000 membrane matrix has numerical yield, uniformity, leakage, bake, dose, timing, and interface kill thresholds. The budget remains tight and must be replaced by quotes before commitment.

G4.rationale: Incom, Exosens/Photonis, Hamamatsu, and BNL in-house detector architecture are direct substitutes. The only defensible wedge is the externally sourced diamond transmission-gain membrane/process cartridge named by the buyer, not a complete MCP-PMT or cosmetic package.

G5.rationale: No nonexistent physics is assumed. The experiment directly tests transfer yield, surface stability, dose life, charging, and added timing spread.

G6.rationale: The base case is US-only scientific supply with normal high-voltage, UHV, materials-traceability, radiation-qualification, and restricted-end-use screening.

G7.rationale: Base ePIC photosensor procurement is explicitly excluded because it freezes too early. The countable 2030 socket is limited to funded EIC Detector II, upgrades, spares, and adjacent US fast-photon programs. Official EIC work extends through 2035, but Detector II funding is not yet committed; kill at end-2029 without paid qualification or a funded design-in.

candidate_verdicts.load_bearing_condition: Use only the post-freeze Detector II/upgrades thesis and apply the 2029 commercial kill.

candidate_verdicts.load_bearing_failure: PPPL already owns rotating Lorentz-force-flowmeter IP and has initiated an ultrasonic diagnostic; the proposed self-reference does not yet prove a non-absorbable merchant wedge or 40 dB field rejection.
The exact polarimetry need is real, but the detailed detector/electronics schedule awards and receives the work in 2027-2028. No independent funded post-freeze 2030 merchant trigger was established.

unsupported_claims_not_made: No claim that base ePIC photosensor procurement remains open to a 2030 entrant.
No claim that EIC Detector II construction funding is committed.
No claim of a signed startup purchase order or paid qualification.
No claim that the diamond cartridge defeats incumbent complete-tube products before the blinded experiment.
